title: Oracle signs 10-year software contract with Pentagon worth up to $7 billion (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Oracle signs 10-year software contract with Pentagon worth up to $7 billion … The Pentagon on Thursday announced a contract with Oracle worth almost $7 billion over a decade, a big win for the software maker, which has been punished by investors this year. The stock rose about 3% in extended trading.
